name: deapi
title: deAPI
description: Generate images, videos and speech, transcribe links and files, and edit, upscale or remove backgrounds from images with open-source models on deAPI. Requires a deAPI account and paid API credits.
author: pietrus-914

commands.title: Generate Image

commands.title: Edit Image

tools.name: generate-image
tools.title: Generate Image
tools.description: Generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL and local file path. Use it when the user asks for a picture, illustration, photo or artwork.

tools.name: transcribe-link
tools.title: Transcribe Link
tools.description: Transcribes the speech in a public YouTube, X (Twitter), TikTok, Twitch or Kick video and returns the text. Use it to summarize, quote or answer questions about a video.

tools.name: generate-speech
tools.title: Generate Speech
tools.description: Reads text aloud with a natural voice and saves it as an MP3 file. Returns the file path.

ai.instructions: deAPI runs open-source media models. Generating an image costs a fraction of a cent and takes a few seconds, so call the tool directly instead of asking for confirmation. When an image is generated, show it to the user with Markdown image syntax using the returned URL. For transcriptions, answer from the returned text and quote it when useful.
